newsitem.title: USA: Packard Bioscience issues $150 mln 10-year debt.
newsitem.headline: Packard Bioscience issues $150 mln 10-year debt.

text.p: The following debt issue from Packard Bioscience Co was priced in the 144A private placement market on Friday, according to a high-yield syndicate source.
Merrill Lynch & Co Inc was lead manager on the deal.
Co-managers were BA Securities Inc and CIBC Wood Gundy Securities Corp.
The deal was increased in size by $50 million.
